notes.zh-CN: 设置里点「Trae 登录」不再报 zsh: command not found: open -e：终端会创建并打开 ~/.trae/config.yaml（仍尊重 $EDITOR），填好 API Key 后重连即可。模型菜单在模型列表返回之前就显示已保存的模型，切换同一 CLI 的其他项目也不再清空列表。macOS 为通用包；Windows 为未签名安装包；APK 调试签名，IPA 开发签名（仅限团队已注册设备）。
notes.en: Clicking Trae sign-in in Settings no longer fails with zsh: command not found: open -e: the terminal creates and opens ~/.trae/config.yaml (still honouring $EDITOR), so a Trae key can be filled in and the agent reconnected. The model pill now shows the saved model before the catalog arrives, and switching to another project of the same CLI no longer clears the list. macOS ships universal; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK is debug-signed and the IPA is development-signed.
